

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {




let (tx_a, mut rx_a) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




let (tx_b, mut rx_b) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




let __l_select_0 = "user binding survives";




let mut outer_value: Option<String> = None;




let mut inner_value: Option<String> = None;





tokio::select! {
biased;

    


selected_outer = async {
    (rx_a).recv().await


}
 => {

    
outer_value = selected_outer;



print!("outer {}", outer_value.is_some());





tokio::select! {
biased;

    


selected_inner = async {
    (rx_b).recv().await


}
 => {

    
inner_value = selected_inner;



print!("inner {}", inner_value.is_some());




},



    


_ = async {
    ()
}
 => {

    

print!("inner fallback");




},



}





print!("outer body once");




},



    


_ = async {
    ()
}
 => {

    

print!("outer fallback");




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


selected_again = async {
    (rx_a).recv().await


}
 => {

    
outer_value = selected_again;



print!("second assignment");




},



    


_ = async {
    ()
}
 => {

},



}





print!("{}", __l_select_0);




drop((tx_a, tx_b, outer_value, inner_value));




});



    
}
